claims.claim: Proof of address is needed to apply.
claims.note: The documents listed are a passport or national identity card to prove identity; proof of address is never mentioned.

claims.claim: The applicant must have the right to work in the UK.
claims.quote: Apply for your first National Insurance number - you must have the right to live and work in the UK.
claims.note: The right to work is a stated condition of applying.

claims.claim: Right to work documents must be provided as evidence when applying.
claims.note: The application asks for identity documents (a passport or national identity card), not documents proving the right to work.
